snippet.title: Backrooms Anomaly - Announcement trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3451970/BACKROOMS_ANOMALY?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=announcement_trailer

Play the demo on itch.io! https://liminal-space-dev.itch.io/backrooms-anomaly

Trapped in an endless office corridor, every step could be your last. Study your surroundings carefully - a misplaced poster, shifted furniture, or something more sinister might be watching. When anomalies appear, retreat. When all seems normal, advance. But remember: just as you see them, they see you.

Features:
- Meticulously crafted looping Backrooms environment
- VHS camcorder aesthetic
- Position-based ambient audio
- Multiple endings
- Mysterious hazmat-suited figure

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3451970/BACKROOMS_ANOMALY?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=announcement_trailer
